name: com.jlinkdev.beams
description: A composable, gameplay-neutral beam construction kit with strand paths, endpoint providers, procedural rendering, shader animation, and contact-ready geometry.

samples.description: A focused gallery of continuous, curved, electrical, branching, pulsing, and contact-aware beams.
Four reusable prefabs and a comparison scene for trip lasers, mining plasma, golden healing tethers, and tractor streams.
A sweeping volumetric orbital column over a basalt basin with a surface-tracked impact, ejecta, and local bloom.
